name: md-wealth-tax
description: Check and settle Moldova's 2026 wealth tax on residential property and holiday homes owned by an individual. Aggregate the owner's cadastral values and floor areas, exclude land, apply ownership shares and test both statutory gates using the enacted annual forecast salary. Recompute the full-value assessment, check the actual SFS notice fields, separate current tax from arrears and credits, follow the public MPay payment route and retain settlement evidence. Covers fractional and undivided ownership, the November assessment snapshot, notice and payment deadlines, overseas owners and the boundary with local property tax. Use for a wealth-tax notice or an annual eligibility check, rather than a general tax on worldwide financial assets.
